sourceRange: SLB Communications Handbook 2024-12: temperature units pp.69/141/168; SLB name rule §1.1.7 p.4
note: Hand-curated and human-verified against the source PDF. Only high-confidence, unambiguous, notation-only substitutions belong here; the numeric value of any measurement is NEVER altered. spelling[] and closedLists[] are intentionally empty until the full glossary is extracted and reviewed in a later pass (see scripts/extractDeterministicRules.ts and docs). Patterns are applied globally to model-reworded text fields only.

unitSymbols.comment: Handbook: 'Do not use °C for degree Celsius.' Place the unit after the numeric value with a single space, e.g. '50 degC' (pp.69/141/168).
Handbook: 'Do not use °F for degree Fahrenheit.' e.g. '228 degF' (pp.69/141/168).
Handbook: 'Do not use °R for degree Rankine.' (pp.141/168).

abbreviations.comment: Handbook §1.1.7: 'Do not use “Schlumberger” as the spelled-out version of “SLB,” as “SLB” is not an initialism.' (p.4).
